# GeoChain

> A free online geography game where you chain countries together.

GeoChain is a fast-paced geography game at [geo-chain.com](https://www.geo-chain.com). Players connect countries based on rules like shared borders, same continent, or letter patterns — all within a 2-minute timer.

## How It Works

- You start with a random country
- A challenge appears (e.g., "Name a country that borders Germany")
- Type a valid country to extend the chain
- Build the longest chain before time runs out
- Two difficulty levels: Easy and Hard

## Key Features

- 197 countries with accurate border data
- Fuzzy name matching (handles typos and abbreviations like USA, UK, Holland)
- Smart rule engine that prevents dead-end chains
- Per-difficulty leaderboards
- Country facts (capital, population, continent) shown during gameplay
- No sign-up required, completely free
- Works on desktop and mobile

## Rule Types

- **Borders**: Name a country sharing a land border
- **Same Continent**: Name a country on the same continent
- **Starts With Same Letter**: Name a country starting with the same letter
- **Starts With Last Letter**: Name a country starting with the last letter of the previous country
- **Capital Letter Match** (Hard only): Name a country whose capital starts with the same letter
